name: Mines Incremental
desc:
Welcome to Mines Incremental! 

💎 Find Gems and build huge multipliers!
💣 Avoid mines and know when to bank!
⬆️ Buy upgrades and unlock special Tiles!
♻️ Rebirth for Cores and permanent boosts!
👑 Defeat Boss Boards and increase your Mine Level!
⚡ Play Crystal Rush, Overdrive, and Challenge Runs!
🏆 Earns offline!

How many tiles will you risk?

👍 Like and favorite the game for future updates!


Developed by: Clingco
